interactiveChecks.action: Adjudicated settings.floor-plan.tsx handleSave against VAL-SETUP-011 by reading settings.floor-plan.tsx:88-108 and floor-plan-canvas.tsx:598-635
interactiveChecks.observed: A successful PUT followed by a failed fetchFloorPlan GET makes handleSave return false (line 108), so the draft stays dirty and the route keeps the consumed floorPlanVersion; the next Save 409s (stale_version) until 'Reload latest floor plan' or a reload. The write itself returned 200, bumped floor_plan_version and wrote floor_plan.save (rsv-setup-crud.ts:1795-1810), and a reload shows the persisted plan, so VAL-SETUP-011's explicit-Save evidence is satisfied. Non-blocking false-negative report; recommended fix is to take the version from the PUT response.

discoveredIssues.description: Floor-plan save false negative: after a 200 PUT, a failed follow-up fetchFloorPlan makes handleSave return false, leaving a stale expectedFloorPlanVersion so the next Save 409s until 'Reload latest floor plan'. Adjudicated non-blocking against VAL-SETUP-011 (the save persisted, version incremented, audit written; reload shows the saved plan).
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Derive the saved version and banner from the PUT response (rsv-setup-crud.ts:1818-1824 already returns it) instead of the follow-up GET, and refresh the baseline lazily.

discoveredIssues.description: Pacing rule channel select offers `phone`/`walk_in` (settings.services.tsx:1178-1182) while the API schema allows only `all|online` (packages/reservations/src/schemas/setup.ts:266, matching VAL-SETUP-020); choosing those options yields a 400.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Restrict the select to all|online, or deliberately extend the API/engine channel enum in a later milestone.

discoveredIssues.description: `covers_actual` was added by editing migration 0016 in place; the idempotent ALTER only runs on the Node/LibSQL path and seed script (refreshReservationsTriggers, packages/tenant-db/src/migrations.ts:212), while the Durable Object worker runs only migrate (apps/tenant-api/workers/tenant-org.ts:43). Not reproducible in this mission (nothing deployed; all local DBs and the Node runtime are correct), but a pre-existing production DO would miss the column.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Before any deploy: add a numbered migration for the DO path, or call refreshReservationsTriggers from the DO ensureDb()/provision path.

discoveredIssues.description: Most setup CRUD passes the constant 'setup' (not the org id) as the withSetupWrite lock key (apps/tenant-api/src/lib/reservations-write.ts:56): setup writes serialize globally and not against org-keyed booking writes. No data loss observed (SQLite writer locking plus retry).
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Pass the real org id as the lock key for setup mutations.
